channel.title: Wire — Cloud
channel.description: Cloud from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: The new AgentCore Runtime is now available in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
item.description: Today, AWS announces the availability of the next generation of AgentCore Runtime , the serverless microVM compute within Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Builder Center now available as mobile app on iOS and Android
item.description: AWS Builder Center is a platform that brings together the global builder community, offering articles, workshops, sandbox environments, events, and learning resources in one place. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Quick now generates individual sheets and builds analyses from an image
item.description: Amazon Quick now expands Generate Analysis with two new ways to create dashboards faster. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS PrivateLink announces Tunnel Endpoints to access network segments
item.description: AWS PrivateLink customers can now use VPC endpoint to privately and securely access network segments in another VPC/account. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon ECS deployment observability for Amazon ECS Managed Daemons in AWS Management Console
item.description: Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) now provides a consolidated deployment view for Amazon ECS Managed Daemons, giving you a single place to see how far a deployment has progressed, what is failing, and what could stop it. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon SES now supports tenant-level deliverability insights
item.description: Amazon Simple Email Service (SES) now supports tenant-level deliverability insights in Virtual Deliverability Manager (VDM). Tenant management allows email senders to isolate email sending across customers, business units, or applications. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Cloudflare Measures Origin TLS Preferences, Cutting Handshake Retries from 52% to 3.7%
item.description: Cloudflare has replaced its static X25519 guess for origin TLS handshakes with per-origin measurement. HelloRetryRequests on scanned origins fell from roughly 52% to 3.7%, removing over 150 ms from p90 latency. (1 source: infoq)
